resources.string: Create your personal account first. After signing in, create a company or ask to join your team.
Choose your company or create one. You can use your profile while your membership is pending.
Review membership requests and manage access to your company.
Your membership is active. You can use incidents and notifications.
Your access was revoked. You can request to rejoin your original company.
No companies found. Try a different name.
Create a company only if you will manage its team. You will become its employer. Each account can belong to one company.
Create %1$s? You will manage this company and will need to sign in again. Any pending request to another company will be cancelled.
Company created. Sign in again to activate your employer access.
Request to join %1$s? Access starts after its employer approves you. Once approved, this will be the only company for this account.
Request sent. Your employer must approve it. Refresh to check its status.
Your request is pending. You can edit your profile while you wait. Sign in again after approval.
Approved · sign in again to activate access
Rejected · you may send another request
Request approved. The worker must sign in again.
Revoke access for %1$s (%2$s)? Their active sessions will be closed. Their account and company binding remain.
Access revoked. Previous sessions can no longer access the company.
This action conflicts with the current state. The company name may be taken or a request may already exist. Refresh before trying again.
The company or request is no longer available. Refresh and try again.
